description.value: Burdock & Co is a Michelin-starred fine dining restaurant in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, opened by Chef Andrea Carlson in 2013 and the first Canadian restaurant owned and operated by a female chef to earn that distinction. The kitchen builds hyper-seasonal, botanically-driven tasting menus — called Moon Menus — around wild-foraged and locally grown Pacific Northwest ingredients that shift every two months. A bar area accepts walk-ins for individual courses and snacks, offering a more casual entry point into the experience.
